authorized_scope: Step 1 source qualification only, using the already-downloaded 26-month GC files. No additional Databento requests or spending; no feature build, fit, TEST access, native change, broker/live/paper action, or trade.
max_records_basis: For each gzip CSV, max_records is the exact decompressed_csv_bytes recorded in the hash-bound local receipt. This is a deterministic upper bound on the number of CSV records, not a fitted or guessed sample size.

audit_disposition: Structural and daily source-quality diagnostics only. A successful run does not establish continuous coverage, source entitlement, feature parity, model admission, economics, or strategy quality.
prebinding_probe_handling: The disclosed one-row prebinding preview remains part of its complete file. The full file will be hash-verified and audited in the same manner as all other inputs; the earlier preview is not used separately for thresholds or conclusions.
